title: Putnami translation catalog
description: One namespace's translations in one locale, at locales/<locale>/<namespace>.json: each message key holds its translation, the default text it was made from, and its state.

text.description: The translation, in ICU MessageFormat; empty while the entry is missing.

source.description: The default text the translation was made from. When the code's default text differs, the entry is stale.

state.description: missing: nobody translated it. draft: an agent or a contributor wrote it. validated: a person locked it. stale: its default text changed since.

validatedBy.description: Who validated it: their git user.name and user.email, as `Name <email>`.

validatedAt.description: The day it was validated, as YYYY-MM-DD.
